Lucy 's friend Lucy的朋友 Lily 's book Lily的书 My mother 's bag 我妈妈的包 My father 's watch 我爸爸的手表 The dog 's name 那只小狗的名字 My mother 's handbag 我妈妈的手提包 The man 's wife 那位男士的妻子 My boss 's office 我老板的办公室 The photo of my school 我学校的照片 The name of the song 这首歌的名字 The color of my car 我的车的颜色 The window of the room 这房间的窗户 The color of the book 那本书的颜色 The map of the world 世界地图 The name of the movie 那部电影的名字 Their classroom 他们的教室 Our teacher 我们的老师 My books 我的一些书 Your dog 你(们)的狗 Her toys 她的玩具 His phone 他的手机 Its food 它的食物

sentences.title: 单词句型 介词练习
lines: 4 beside [bɪ'saɪd] prep. 在…的旁边 off [ɒf] [ɔːf] prep. 离开 Where is...?
There is a bed table beside the bed.
He sat beside her all night. 整个晚上他都坐在她的身边。
He felt something move beside him. 他感觉到身边有东西在移动。
beside s adv.而且，再说 prep. 除…之外（还） Besides this, they also faced many difficulties. 除此之外，他们还面临许多困难。
I'm off duty. 我下班了。
The wedding is off . 婚礼被取消了。
The paint had chipped off . 油漆已经剥落。
turn off 关掉（电源、水源等） Please turn off the lights before you leave the room. 请在离开房间前关灯。
take off 脱掉（衣物）；起飞；减（价） The plane is scheduled to take off at 8 p.m. 飞机定于晚上8点起飞。
drive off （驾驶车辆）离去，开走 He got into his car and drove off without saying a word. 他上车后一言不发地开走了。
jump off 跳离；从……跳下 The stuntman had to jump off the moving train into the river. 特技演员不得不从行驶的火车上跳入河中。
He is going into the book store.
She is going out of the book store.
The boy is sitting beside his mother.

expand.title: 扩展知识 名词所有格
lines: 3 每日习语 bite the bullet 咬紧牙关, 硬着头皮做
Jim 's room Jim的房间
Jack 's room Jack的房间
Jim and Jack 's room Jim和Jack的房间 (表示他们共同拥有的房间)
Jim 's and Jack 's rooms Jim和Jack各自的房间 (表示各自拥有的房间)
Lucy and Sara 's boyfriend Lucy和Sara的男朋友 (表示 共同拥有 一个男朋友)
Lucy 's and Sara 's boyfriend s Lucy和Sara各自的男朋友 (表示各自 拥有不同 的男朋友)
